detailsSample.description: Located on Dubai's prominent Sheikh Zayed Road, this 4-star hotel offers stunning views of the Arabian Sea and easy access to major attractions. Minutes from Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai Mall, it's also a short drive from Burj Khalifa, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai International Airport. The hotel features award-winning dining options, including a fusion restaurant and the longest bar in the Middle East. Business travelers will appreciate the contemporary facilities and nine meeting rooms. For recreation, guests can enjoy the top-floor outdoor pool, sun terrace, fitness center, steam room, sauna, and jacuzzi overlooking Jumeirah Beach.
